title: Tuenti
summary: Gamification, top-ups and payments in Tuenti and Telefónica products, from Tsoft. From the frontend to backend logic and deployments.

tldr.v: Reward mechanics such as the Tuenti roulette and the referral system, a dashboard to measure them, automatic top-up and the payments module.
With multidisciplinary teams, turning business requirements into technical solutions.
Architecture, data, metrics or screenshots: they are confidential.

p: Since 2024 I've worked at Tsoft on Tuenti and Telefónica products. I joined as a Jr Frontend Developer focused on gamification and in 2026 I became a Ssr AI Fullstack Developer.

steps.d: Gamification: interactive and reward mechanics, such as the Tuenti roulette and the referral system. Then, a dashboard measuring referrals, recurrence and gamification.
An internal recognition from Tsoft, with a message and a gesture from the People team.
Promotion, and an in-person day with clients in Buenos Aires: demos, alignment and direct conversation.
I designed and built CompliA, built Supernova Eventos and trained colleagues to raise the team's level. In the Tuenti app: top-up processes, internal flows, backend and deployments.

items.d: Interactive and reward mechanics to improve engagement, such as the Tuenti roulette and the referral system.
I built a dashboard to measure Tuenti's data: referrals, recurrence and gamification.
Automatic top-up and the payments module.

items.t: End to end in the app
items.d: Internal flows, backend logic, deployment pipelines and integrations.
Turning business requirements into technical solutions, alongside multidisciplinary teams.

p: Gamification is product, not decoration: every mechanic needs a reason for people to come back. And in a large company, the technical side moves faster once the business requirement is understood first.
For confidentiality I don't show architecture, data, metrics or internal screenshots from Tuenti, Telefónica or Tsoft. The illustrations on this page are my own drawings, with fictional data.
I don't show Tuenti screenshots for confidentiality. These illustrations are mine: they explain the three pieces without showing the product or its data.

wheel.d: A reward mechanic: you spin, win a prize and get a reason to come back.

referrals.d: You invite someone; when they join, you both get something. That's how the base grows.

dashboard.d: Measuring referrals, recurrence and gamification to know which mechanic works.
